song_craft: Unworldly upsurge song (13v): grace-devotion rooting (v1) → chewing-contentment (v2) → worldlike-thirst (v3) → plain-by-Thyself (v4) → thrilled-seats (v5) → five-quality picturing (v6) → bloom-untellable (v7) → gorge-filled (v8) → thinnest-wager (v9) → hamsa-wading (v10) → Come-All (v11) → strait joy-mad (v12) → SEAL woven-shown plain (v13). Opens held open throughout (10 UNC pairs) — the song refuses to decide what the analysis leaves open.

lines: A grace-drop, Lord-abiding; devotion, as if, nearing me —
the two, each in other — when will they root in such a body?
l4.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ prasādalava īśvarasthito yā ca bhaktir iva mām upeyuṣī tau parasparasamanvitau kadā tādṛśe vapuṣi rūḍhim eṣyataḥ

verses.craft: Grace-drop + nearing-devotion; each-in-other rooting; such-body open ×2 per UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'prasādalava' means 'drop of grace' or 'grace's drop' (genitive) is unresolved.", "Whether 'tādṛśe vapuṣi' refers to the devotee's body or the Lord's body is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Born of chewing Thy mastery whole —
may some contentment-sap rise within; ever here be highest for me — knowledge, yoga, glories far off.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā ko 'py udetu paritoṣaraso 'ntaḥ sarvakālam iha me param astu jñānayogamahimādi vidūre

verses.rejected: (a) ko-pi/me-param resolved → killed by UNC. (b) contentment→joy → killed: contentment contents.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'ko 'pi' (some) refers to joy-juice or to a person is unresolved.", "Whether 'param' (supreme) modifies 'astu' or 'me' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Worldlike be my thirst 'mid sense-things —
swollen full, utter, Lord. Only as Thy body may I behold them — I, thought-unbuilt.
l4.sanskrit_cite: lokavadbhavatu me viṣayeṣu sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ kevalaṃ tava śarīratayaitān+ lokayeyam aham astavikalpaḥ

verses.craft: Worldlike-thirst swollen-utter; thought-unbuilt; both readings open per UNC.
verses.rejected: (a) picking thirst-sense → killed. (b) unbuilt→free → killed: unbuilt unbuilds.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'bhagavanparitarṣaḥ' means 'thirst for You, Lord' or 'thirst, O Lord' is unresolved.", "Whether 'astavikalpaḥ' means 'unconstructed' or 'without alternative' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: In body-grounds, in mind, Thou — where breath's run has met difference —
and on those knowing-paths: thereby, by Thine own self, be plain to me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dehabhūmiṣu tathā manasi tvaṃ prāṇavartmani ca bhedam upete saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca tena svātmanā mama bhava sphuṭarūpaḥ

verses.craft: Body-grounds breath-difference; plain-by-Thyself (tena open); sphuṭa open kept.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'sphuṭarūpaḥ' means 'plain' or 'manifest' is unresolved.", "Whether 'tena' refers to Yourself or to the path is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: May these thrilled sense-plays of mine fall each to its own seat —
never, Lord, not an instant, not a jot, the outrage: wounding Thy undifference-sap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā mama kṣaṇamapīśa manāg api maiva bhūt tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam

verses.craft: Thrilled-seats; never-not-instant outrage (kṣaṇamapīśa open); undifference-sap kept (rasa open).
verses.rejected: (a) resolving → killed ×2. (b) outrage→sin → killed: outrage breaks.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'kṣaṇamapīśa' means 'never, Lord, even for a moment' or 'Lord, even for a moment' is unresolved.", "Whether 'tvadavibhedarasa' means 'the rasa of non-difference' or 'the non-difference-rasa' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Light, soft, white, clear, cool — by Thy possession-force picturing a body —
may I stride past those dealings of the all-things' road.
l4.sanskrit_cite: laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ bhavadāveśavaśena bhāvayan vapur akhilapadārthapaddhater vyavahārān ativartayeya tān

verses.craft: Five-quality picturing; stride-past dealings; body/contemplation + vyavahāra opens kept.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ' describes the body or the contemplation is unresolved.", "Whether 'vyavahāra' means transaction or worldly dealing is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Bloom, my body, Thou-natured; come, worlds, to my limbhood. Pass, all this two-sport —
though on memory's road it come — to untellability.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vikasatu svavapur bhavadātmakaṃ samupayāntu jaganti mamāṅgatām vrajatu sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ smṛtipathopagame 'py anupākhyatām

verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'dvayavalgitaṃ' means 'duality-sport' or 'the sport of duality' is unresolved.", "Whether 'anupākhyatām' means 'untellable' or 'unnameable' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Rise — O glance at such a face of Thine! highest-nectar deluge —
befall me, till filled the dread gorge of Thy unshown oneness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samudiyād api tādṛśatāvakānana viloka parāmṛtasamplavaḥ mama ghaṭeta yathā bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam

verses.craft: Glance-rise deluge; dread-gorge filled; both readings open per UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'tādṛśatāvakānana' means 'such Yours' or 'such a forest of Yours' is unresolved.", "Whether 'ghoradarī' means 'dread gorge' or 'terrible cave' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: If ever, dusted thinnest with Thy meeting-nectar-drops, I turn not from all world-joys —
or fallen from both — what then?
l4.sanskrit_cite: api kadācana tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā sakalalokasukheṣu parāṅmukho na bhavitāsmy ubhayacyuta eva kim

verses.craft: Thinnest-dusted turn-or-fallen-both; kim open (question kept questioning).
verses.rejected: (a) answering kim → killed open. (b) both→either → killed: both falls.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'ubhayacyuta' means 'fallen from both' or 'fallen from both sides' is unresolved.", "Whether 'kim' is a question or a rhetorical exclamation is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: I, choice hamsa, ever wading Thy foot-lotus-lake —
above, from root-depth, from within: bend up, love's lotus-stalk — O Unborn.
l4.sanskrit_cite: satatam eva bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya hi haṃsavarasya me upari mūlatalād api cāntarād upanamatv aja bhaktimṛṇālikā

verses.craft: Choice-hamsa wading; lotus-stalk bend-up; both readings open per UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'haṃsavarasya' means 'best hamsa' or 'swan-king' is unresolved.", "Whether 'bhaktimṛṇālikā' means 'devotion's lotus-stalk' or 'the stalk of devotion' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Come, All, all things —
'neath thought's reach, 'neath sight's footing for me; sight-thought-shine-nectar-piths — shimmer supreme.
l4.sanskrit_cite: upayāntu vibho samastavastūny api cintāviṣayaṃ dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca mama darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi paraṃ parisphurantu

verses.craft: Come-All summons; thought-reach sight-footing; shimmer-supreme close.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'cintāviṣayaṃ' means 'under thought's scope' or 'as thought's object' is unresolved.", "Whether 'parisphurantu' means 'blaze' or 'manifest' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: High-Lord, in strait on strait, when names themselves bow down —
may I be not merely fear-gone, but, Thy limbs lending, joy-mad past measure.
l4.sanskrit_cite: parameśvara teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api nāmopanamatsv ahaṃ bhaveyam na paraṃ gatabhīs tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado 'pi yāvat

verses.craft: Strait-on-strait; names-bowing; limbs-lending joy-mad (gatabhīs/yāvat opens kept).
verses.rejected: (a) mad→wild → killed: mad mads. (b) fear-gone→fearless → killed: gone-ness moves.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'gatabhīs' means 'fear gone' or 'gone fear' is unresolved.", "Whether 'yāvat' means 'while' or 'as long as' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Woven in Thy self, the world — by Thee alone shown outside.
What hard resolve holds — now may it shine plain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavadātmani viśvam umbhitaṃ yad bhavataivāpi bahiḥ prakāśyate tat iti yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām

verses.craft: SEAL: self-woven world shown-outside; hard-resolve shines-plain (umbhita/dṛḍha opens kept).
verses.rejected: (a) woven→made → killed: woven weaves. (b) plain→clear → killed: plain shows.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'umbhitaṃ' means 'woven' or 'born' is unresolved.", "Whether 'dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ' modifies 'tat' or 'mahimā' is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice
